steps.title: Thaw and resuspend pellets
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen cell pellets on ice and resuspend in 50 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer.

steps.title: Transfect Sf9 cells
steps.instruction: Transfect 1 × 10⁶ Sf9 cells in a 6‑well plate with 2500 ng purified bacmid DNA mixed with FuGENE HD transfection reagent.

steps.title: Harvest V0 and infect 40 mL
steps.instruction: Ten days post‑transfection, harvest the first viral stock (V0) and use it to infect 40 mL Sf9 cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Incubate and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Incubate infected culture for 4 days at 27 °C, then harvest cells by centrifugation at 2000 rpm for 15 min.

steps.title: Generate V2 virus
steps.instruction: When cytopathic effect appears, centrifuge the culture, collect the supernatant (V1), and add 1 mL V1 to 30 mL Sf9 cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹ to generate V2.

steps.title: Infect large‑scale culture
steps.instruction: After three days, add 20 mL of V2 to 2 L Sf9 cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Harvest large‑scale cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells when viability drops to 90–95% (≈5 days post‑infection), wash with PBS, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend frozen cell pellet on ice in ice‑cold lysis buffer, gently pipette, then Dounce homogenize with 10 strokes loose pestle followed by 2 × 20 strokes tight pestle.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysate at 9000 rpm for 15 min using a Sorvall RC6+ (F21S rotor).

steps.title: Pellet membranes
steps.instruction: Ultracentrifuge the supernatant at 40 000 rpm (~186 000 × g) for 1 h at 4 °C on a Beckman XPN90 (Ti45 rotor) to pellet membranes.

steps.title: Resuspend membrane pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the membrane pellet in lysis buffer containing 0.3 % DDM using a Dounce homogenizer.

steps.title: Solubilize membranes
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension for 2 h at 4 °C with gentle rolling.

steps.title: Remove debris
steps.instruction: Ultracentrifuge again at 40 000 rpm for 1 h at 4 °C to remove insoluble debris.

steps.title: Load HisTrap column
steps.instruction: Load the cleared DDM‑solubilized supernatant onto a 1 mL HisTrap HP column (Cytiva, Cat# 17524802) pre‑equilibrated with water and elution buffer.

steps.title: Wash and elute protein
steps.instruction: Wash the column and elute ATG9A using a stepwise imidazole gradient of 80, 150, 200, and 300 mM in elution buffer.

steps.title: Identify peak fractions
steps.instruction: Analyze elution fractions by SDS‑PAGE and Coomassie staining to locate ATG9A‑containing peaks.

steps.title: Concentrate peak fractions
steps.instruction: Pool the peak fractions and concentrate them with a 100 kDa MWCO Amicon Ultra centrifugal filter.

steps.title: Size‑exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Run the concentrate on a Superose 6 Increase 10/300 GL column equilibrated with water and SEC buffer.

steps.title: Aliquot and store protein
steps.instruction: Pool ATG9A‑containing SEC fractions, aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.
